title: hemionitis × marchettiana
intro: Hemionitis × marchettiana, commonly known as Marchettiana fern, is a hybrid species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Marchettiana fern are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and promote overall well-being, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
